definitions.explanation: The length of a garment's sleeve, measured from the shoulder seam to the end of the cuff. A standard clothing measurement.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{袖丈|そでたけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
{袖丈|そでたけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{詰|つ}めて→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the sleeve length taken in a little.

examples.japanese: オーダー⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{肩幅|かたはば}→肩幅：27827_katahaba⟧や{袖丈|そでたけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: For a tailor-made suit, they measure the shoulder width and sleeve length in detail.

notes:
The length of a sleeve, one of the basic measurements used when buying or altering clothes. Measured from the shoulder seam to the end of the cuff.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {袖丈|そでたけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: the sleeves are long
- {袖丈|そでたけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧: to shorten the sleeve length
- {袖丈|そでたけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure the sleeve length

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着丈|きたけ}: garment length — the length of the body of the garment
- {裄丈|ゆきたけ}: back-sleeve length — measured from the center back to the cuff, used for kimono and shirts
